The '''Shogun system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Quence sector/Legends|Quence sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shogun (planet)|Shogun]].
